title: gtrack editor: new gnaural-track editor on one form with wave + spectrum

decisions.text: New editor beside the old one (2026-07-08). New GTrack* components; GnauralEditorPanel/GnauralScheduleView untouched. Reuse: GnauralScheduleData protocol model, dump-schedule, gnaural-editor-store (save+validate), spectrogram-audio-source render bridge, SF-D66 unified track stack.

Host = Audio tab shared stack (owner choice 2026-07-08). gtrack lanes are kind:'gtrack' in the unified track model; shared time view/zoom/pan/minimap/resizers/eye/drag/gear. Lanes appear only when a .gnaural is open.
Wave/spectrum beside gtracks = gnaural render -> WAV (owner choice 2026-07-08), via the existing spectrogram-audio-source mechanism. After Save: invalidate analysis + re-render (button; auto later).

Editing = in-memory model + Save (owner choice 2026-07-08). Reactive editable copy, undo/redo in memory, dirty flag, Save (button + Ctrl+S) writes through the existing store with Gnaural.exe validation.

Save = PATCH the source XML, not regeneration (owner 2026-07-08, risk-driven). --dump-schedule model may be lossy (waveform types, phases, etc. absent), so Save parses the original XML, updates only touched entry/voice values, and serializes back - unknown fields survive. Full regeneration only if patching proves unviable (would need a new decision).
Derived axes: Beat freq displayed as 2x beatFreqHalf; Volume=(volL+volR)/2; Stereo balance derived from volL/volR; editing Volume/Balance maps back to volL/volR (mono: volL only).
Wave<->XML synchronization is Phase 5: design discussion with the owner first, code only after a separate go.
